complete-kyrgyzstan-adventure-12-days.hook: Our most complete trip: ride, trek, and off-road in one.
complete-kyrgyzstan-adventure-12-days.text: Three days on horseback over the Song-Kul jailoo, three on foot to the Ala-Kul pass, and a rough drive to the hidden lake at Kel-Suu. Twelve days, yurt nights beside herders, and a warm finish on the shore of Issyk-Kul.

grand-kyrgyzstan-road-trip-12-days.hook: Our longest road trip: every highlight, no hiking.
grand-kyrgyzstan-road-trip-12-days.text: Twelve relaxed days by car and 4x4, from Song-Kul and Kel-Suu to Karakol, Chong-Kemin, and the Burana tower. The fullest loop we run for people who would rather ride than walk.

tash-rabat-kel-suu-road-trip-11-days.hook: The long driving loop, one day shorter.
tash-rabat-kel-suu-road-trip-11-days.text: Eleven days linking Song-Kul, Kel-Suu, and the Altyn-Arashan gorge, with off-road stretches and yurt nights. Nearly the full road trip, minus the final city day.

tash-rabat-kel-suu-ala-kul-11-days.hook: Almost the full grand loop, one day lighter.
tash-rabat-kel-suu-ala-kul-11-days.text: The same Song-Kul ride, Kel-Suu detour, and Ala-Kul trek as our twelve-day trip, trimmed to eleven. Best if you want nearly everything but have a little less time.

kyrgyzstan-grand-tour-10-days.hook: Our original grand loop, start to finish.
kyrgyzstan-grand-tour-10-days.text: Our first and most-loved grand loop: ride to Song-Kul, off-road to Kel-Suu, then trek the Altyn-Arashan and Ala-Kul high country. Ten days that became the template for all the rest.

song-kul-to-ala-kul-on-horseback-10-days.hook: The most saddle time we offer.
song-kul-to-ala-kul-on-horseback-10-days.text: Ten days riding from the Song-Kul pastures to Issyk-Kul and up the Altyn-Arashan valley to Ala-Kul, with fresh horses along the way. You ride every day and sleep mostly in yurts.

slow-ride-trek-to-ala-kul-10-days.hook: More saddle and trail, less time in the car.
slow-ride-trek-to-ala-kul-10-days.text: Four riding days to Song-Kul and three trekking days to Ala-Kul, with the shortest drives of any ten-day trip. For people who would rather move under their own power than sit in a van.

kel-suu-chong-kemin-road-trip-10-days.hook: Ten days driving the big lakes and back roads.
kel-suu-chong-kemin-road-trip-10-days.text: Song-Kul, Kel-Suu, and the south shore of Issyk-Kul, linked by easy drives and one rough off-road run to Altyn-Arashan. A full road trip with no demanding hikes.

song-kul-kok-kiya-kel-suu-9-days.hook: The grand loop without the Ala-Kul climb.
song-kul-kok-kiya-kel-suu-9-days.text: Song-Kul on horseback, Kel-Suu by 4x4, and the Altyn-Arashan hot springs, minus the hardest trek. Nine days for travellers who want the highlights but not the steepest pass.

song-kul-kel-suu-road-trip-9-days.hook: The big three, no boots required.
song-kul-kel-suu-road-trip-9-days.text: Song-Kul, remote Kel-Suu, and the Altyn-Arashan gorge in nine driving days, with a yurt night and an off-road push to the hidden lake. Built for travellers who skip the trekking.

kok-kiya-kel-suu-road-trip-8-days.hook: Top three sights, eight quick days.
kok-kiya-kel-suu-road-trip-8-days.text: A faster run at Song-Kul, Kel-Suu, and Altyn-Arashan, with a yurt stay and hot springs along the way. Most of the long road trip, packed tighter.

talas-to-issyk-kul-backroads-8-days.hook: Eight days off the tourist map, with nomad families.
talas-to-issyk-kul-backroads-8-days.text: Through the quiet Talas region, Besh-Tash lake, and villages most tours never reach, sleeping in family homes and yurts. The famous sights too, but always from the back roads.

song-kul-kel-suu-altyn-arashan-8-days.hook: The grand loop, in eight tight days.
song-kul-kel-suu-altyn-arashan-8-days.text: Ride to Song-Kul, drive out to Kel-Suu, and walk the easy valley up to the Altyn-Arashan hot springs. Quick-moving days that still hit the country's three signature spots.

kyzyl-oi-song-kul-chong-kemin-8-days.hook: Eight active days, light on driving.
kyzyl-oi-song-kul-chong-kemin-8-days.text: Two days riding to Song-Kul, the south shore of Issyk-Kul, then a two-day trek into Altyn-Arashan. Short transfers, real days outdoors, no long highway stretches.

kol-ukok-to-song-kul-horse-trek-7-days.hook: For seasoned riders: hard passes, two alpine lakes.
kol-ukok-to-song-kul-horse-trek-7-days.text: Seven demanding days between Song-Kul and Kol-Ukok, over high passes and rugged trails few groups ever take. You will need real riding skills and a head for remote country.

kyrgyzstan-overland-road-trip-7-days.hook: See the most in a single week of driving.
kyrgyzstan-overland-road-trip-7-days.text: Song-Kul, Kel-Suu, and Altyn-Arashan in seven days, with thrilling off-road stretches and a yurt night. The quick road trip for travellers short on time.

two-lakes-kok-bulak-horse-trek-7-days.hook: A full week on horseback, lakes included.
two-lakes-kok-bulak-horse-trek-7-days.text: Four riding days up to Song-Kul, a guesthouse rest, then the saddle again along Issyk-Kul's south shore. Open pastures, mountain passes, and nomad camps for seven days.

song-kul-horse-trek-ala-kul-hike-7-days.hook: Ride to Song-Kul, then trek to Ala-Kul.
song-kul-horse-trek-ala-kul-hike-7-days.text: Our two signature trips back to back: three days in the saddle on the high pastures, three days on foot to the glacier lake at Ala-Kul. One week, two very different kinds of mountain.

easy-week-song-kul-issyk-kul-7-days.hook: Gentlest route: best for families and first-timers.
easy-week-song-kul-issyk-kul-7-days.text: A week by road between Song-Kul and Issyk-Kul, with the Altyn-Arashan gorge, Chong-Kemin park, and easy walks only. No hard driving, no long hikes, just the mountains at a calm pace.

talas-to-song-kul-backroads-7-days.hook: The offbeat Talas route, in a week.
talas-to-song-kul-backroads-7-days.text: Seven days through hidden valleys, Besh-Tash lake, and nomad camps near Song-Kul, far from the usual crowds. A shorter take on our deepest, most local road trip.

song-kul-kel-suu-in-a-week-7-days.hook: The whole loop in one week.
song-kul-kel-suu-in-a-week-7-days.text: Ride to Song-Kul, then road-trip to Kel-Suu and Issyk-Kul across high passes and canyons. Fast, full, and seven days flat.

elena-tabers-tour-7-days.hook: The route we built for YouTuber Elena Taber.
elena-tabers-tour-7-days.text: Two days on horseback at Song-Kul with a yurt night, a scenic drive through the highlights, and a two-day trek to the Altyn-Arashan hot springs. Her exact trip, open to you.

ichke-tor-lake-horse-trek-6-days.hook: Off-grid riding where tourism hasn't reached.
ichke-tor-lake-horse-trek-6-days.text: Six days across remote valleys and hidden passes to Song-Kul, sleeping in yurts and a shepherd's house. Real nomad families, no crowds, no signal, just the high country.

kilemche-song-kul-altyn-arashan-6-days.hook: A six-day taste of riding and trekking.
kilemche-song-kul-altyn-arashan-6-days.text: Three days on horseback to Song-Kul, the south shore of Issyk-Kul, then a two-day walk into the Altyn-Arashan valley. The active combo, condensed to under a week.

two-lakes-west-shore-horse-trek-6-days.hook: Six days riding from the pastures to the lake.
two-lakes-west-shore-horse-trek-6-days.text: Four days in the saddle to Song-Kul, a night in a warm guesthouse, then a ride along the south shore of Issyk-Kul. A shorter version of our week-long horseback loop.

song-kul-ride-altyn-arashan-trek-5-days.hook: Ride and trek, both in five days.
song-kul-ride-altyn-arashan-trek-5-days.text: Two saddle days up to Song-Kul and a two-day trek to Altyn-Arashan, with Issyk-Kul in between. The shortest way to do horseback and hiking in one trip.

kel-suu-issyk-kul-express-5-days.hook: Reach hidden Kel-Suu in just five days.
kel-suu-issyk-kul-express-5-days.text: A night in a Song-Kul yurt, a trek to the remote lake at Kel-Suu, and Issyk-Kul views on the way home. Fast-paced, for travellers who want the far corners without the long itinerary.

mai-tor-pastures-horse-trek-5-days.hook: More about the nomads than the miles.
mai-tor-pastures-horse-trek-5-days.text: Five riding days to Song-Kul, staying in yurts and a shepherd's house and sharing the daily rhythm of herder life. A horseback trip built around people, not just trails.

two-lakes-horse-trek-5-days.text: Three days on horseback up to Song-Kul, then the saddle along Issyk-Kul's south shore after a guesthouse night. A compact ride through high pastures and lakeside trails.

song-kul-issyk-kul-road-trip-5-days.hook: The short scenic loop, easy for everyone.
song-kul-issyk-kul-road-trip-5-days.text: Song-Kul, the south shore of Issyk-Kul, and the Altyn-Arashan gorge in five gentle days, with a yurt night and light walking. Comfortable for families and anyone who wants nature without the effort.

kel-suu-lake-express-4-days.hook: Song-Kul and Kel-Suu in four days flat.
kel-suu-lake-express-4-days.text: A yurt night above Song-Kul, a short trek to the hidden lake at Kel-Suu, and Issyk-Kul on the drive back. The quickest way to reach two of the country's wildest spots.

issyk-kul-altyn-arashan-4-days.text: The Fairy-Tale canyons, Barskoon waterfalls, Jety-Oguz red rocks, and the Altyn-Arashan hot springs, all around the great lake. One of the few trips that runs from April into November.

song-kul-shoreline-horse-trek-4-days.hook: Pure riding: no transfers, just Song-Kul.
song-kul-shoreline-horse-trek-4-days.text: Four days in the saddle from Kyzart through the Kilemche valley to the lake and back, with zero driving in between. Three yurt nights and nothing but horse and mountain.

family-tour-lakes-eagles-yurts-4-days.hook: Made for families: easy days, no rough roads.
family-tour-lakes-eagles-yurts-4-days.text: Chong-Kemin park, the shore of Issyk-Kul, and a yurt night at Song-Kul, all on smooth driving with optional activities. Relaxed enough for every age in the group.

issyk-kul-karakol-canyons-3-days.hook: A weekend at Lake Issyk-Kul, any season.
issyk-kul-karakol-canyons-3-days.text: Both shores of the lake, the south-shore canyons, and a cozy yurt night, with a stop in Karakol town. The rare trip that runs all year round, snow or sun.

winter-horse-trek-to-song-kul-3-days.hook: Our only winter ride, to a frozen Song-Kul.
winter-horse-trek-to-song-kul-3-days.text: Three days through snowy passes to the iced-over lake, with nights in a warm homestay and yurt. Silent white mountains and a side of Kyrgyzstan few travellers ever see.

issyk-kul-song-kul-weekend-3-days.hook: Two lakes, three days, one easy loop.
issyk-kul-song-kul-weekend-3-days.text: The south shore of Issyk-Kul and a nomad night at Song-Kul, with an eagle hunter visit along the way. A short, comfortable run past Kyrgyzstan's two most famous lakes.

song-kul-horse-trek-3-days.hook: The classic three-day ride to Song-Kul.
song-kul-horse-trek-3-days.text: Up from Kyzart over the Jalgyz-Karagai pass to the lake, a night with herders, and back over Tuz-Ashuu. Our most popular short horseback trip.

song-kul-overnight-horse-trek-2-days.hook: Our shortest trip: one night, one lake.
song-kul-overnight-horse-trek-2-days.text: A two-day ride from Kyzart up to Song-Kul and back, with a single yurt night on the high pasture. The quickest way to sleep under nomad skies.
